name: job_search_plugin
description: Job search, resume/cover-letter enrichment, offer-fit evaluation, and application tracking. Pairs with OpenClaw for browser-hands fallback.
author: Whiskers Agent

scopes.description: Full access to job search tools
Read token-budgeted applicant profile summaries and proof points
Sync application lifecycle status (Career-Ops CLI integration)
Search and fetch job postings (unified ATS ingestion)
Verify posting liveness and ghost-job signals
Tailor resume/cover letter and render PDFs, with optional portfolio auto-bake
Slot-bridging adapter ops used only by the career_ops_apply_v1 FlowSpec

specialist_agent.comment: career_ops_apply_v1 chains ingest/fit/bake/tailor/track into one dispatchable flow for the Career-Ops CLI agent.
